title: Triple-component terminal completion
summary: Candidate terminal DP passed separate-author finite replication on 18,534 cases. Author-route Lean audits cover 36 supporting statements; fresh replay covers 27. G1–G3 and graph/Python correspondence remain open.

claims.label: Exact triple terminal solver
claims.detail: Same-author edge-cut census: 9,660 n=5 plus 8,505 n=6 cases. Fresh-author partition/triple/path oracle: 10,029 n≤5 plus 8,505 n=6 cases and 283,285 total partitions. All pass exact optimum, witness and characterization comparisons. Overlapping domains, finite evidence only.

claims.label: DP operation accounting
claims.detail: Exact K=1+g+6b states; candidates/internal=1+3g+18b; closing scans/internal=2K, plus K at root; backtrace 2n−1 visits. Lean count arithmetic and all executed counters pass; Python runtime refinement remains unproved.

claims.label: Adjacent same-color regions always merge
claims.detail: Frozen one-color incompatible triple has optimum two; merging its regions yields forbidden full triple.

claims.label: Legal baseline child with two overlapping bad triples
claims.detail: Concrete nine-leaf Whidden(t=3) all-pendant branch child: three paid cuts, three additional cuts, seven full components. All nine cross-color pair spans intersect, supplying a finite matching lower bound. Original-instance optimum and safe cover are not claimed.

lemmas.label: Minimum per boundary state preserves optimum
lemmas.detail: Universal theorem over supplied finite transition rules. This does not establish graph-to-rule correspondence.

lemmas.label: Independent child minima factor
lemmas.detail: Lean minimum_pair_sum proves min of Cartesian sum equals sum of minima for nonempty finite lists.

lemmas.label: Proper labelled triple partitions agree
lemmas.detail: Arbitrary distinct labels, three representative shapes, four proper partitions checked universally in RMAF executable semantics. Sibling-swap transport and graph correspondence remain open.

lemmas.label: Root/child path-convex region decomposition
lemmas.detail: Eight supporting statements prove exact single-region root/child decomposition on binary addresses and a counterexample to LCA closure alone. Family disjointness, label trimming and cost preservation remain G2.

lemmas.label: Graph forests correspond to DP derivations
lemmas.detail: G1 suppression/restriction span transfer; G2 cost-preserving graph/derivation directions up to trimming; G3 specialized automaton/Python refinement remain unresolved. Raw-support bijection is unnecessary and false without a normal form.
